description: This file contains utility functions for file operations used within the SuiteCRM project, including path cleaning, directory creation, file handling, MD5 hashing, and MIME type detection.

methods.name: clean_path
methods.description: Converts backslashes to forward slashes, removes redundant '/', './', handling Windows UNC paths.

methods.name: create_cache_directory
methods.description: Creates nested cache directories based on the file path within the cache directory.

methods.name: get_module_dir_list
methods.description: Returns a list of module directories within the 'modules' directory.

methods.name: mk_temp_dir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with an optional prefix.

methods.name: remove_file_extension
methods.description: Removes the extension from a filename.

methods.name: write_array_to_file
methods.description: Outputs a PHP array to a file with optional header.

methods.name: write_override_label_to_file
methods.description: Writes label overrides to a PHP file.

methods.name: write_encoded_file
methods.description: Decodes base64 data and writes it to a specified file, verifying MD5 checksum.

methods.name: create_custom_directory
methods.description: Creates nested custom directories.

methods.name: generateMD5array
methods.description: Recursively generates MD5 hashes for all files in a directory, ignoring specified directories.

methods.name: md5DirCompare
methods.description: Compares MD5 hashes between two directories to find differences.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Gets files matching a pattern recursively within a directory.

methods.name: readfile_chunked
methods.description: Reads a file in chunks and outputs it, useful for large files.

methods.name: sugar_rename
methods.description: Renames a file, deleting target if it exists.

methods.name: fileToHash
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash from a filename and stores it in session.

methods.name: hashToFile
methods.description: Retrieves filename from session based on hash.

methods.name: get_file_extension
methods.description: Returns the extension of a filename.

methods.name: get_mime_content_type_from_filename
methods.description: Guesses mime type based on filename extension.

methods.name: cleanFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes filename by removing unsafe characters.

methods.name: cleanDirName
methods.description: Removes path components from directory name, leaving only name.

methods.name: hasValidFileName
methods.description: Validates filename against a regex pattern.
